newsitem.title: USA: Program trading averaged 16.7 pct of volume - NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Program trading averaged 16.7 pct of volume - NYSE.

text.p: Program trading during July 14 to 18 was 16.7 percent of New York Stock Exchange average daily volume of 592 million shares, or 98.8 million shares a day, the NYSE said Thursday.
The figure included program trading associated with the July 18 monthly expiration of stock-index options and futures.
In all markets, program trading averaged 121.3 million shares a day during July 14 to 18, NYSE said.

About 81.5 percent of program trading took place on the NYSE, 12.3 percent in non-U.S. markets and 6.2 percent in other domestic markets, including Nasdaq, the American Stock Exchange and regional markets.
Program trading includes a range of portfolio trading strategies involving the purchase or sale of a basket of at least 15 stocks with a total value of $1 million or more.
It is calculated as the sum of the shares bought, sold and sold short in program trades, and the total of these shares is divided by total reported volume.
